name: Dewan Ismail
title: Principal & Director of Career Planning & Development
bio: Dewan Ismail is the visionary founder and Principal of the Culinary Academy. With over a decade of experience in culinary education and food safety, he has transformed Culinary Academy into Bangladesh's premier NSDA-accredited culinary training institute. His expertise spans Culinary Science & Arts, Food Science, HACCP & Industrial Hygiene, and Entrepreneurship Development. He holds a BBA and MBA from Jagannath University and a PGD in Tourism & Hospitality Management from DIU. His IELTS score of 7.5 and certifications from SGS Switzerland and ISO UK demonstrate his commitment to international standards. Under his leadership, Culinary Academy has trained thousands of students who now work in 5-star hotels across the Gulf, Europe, and Asia. He is a regular guest on BTV and a recognized voice in Bangladesh's culinary industry.
